quarterly_data.quarter: Pasqal press release: Pasqal Launches an AI-Assisted Workflow to Accelerate Cloud (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal launched an AI-assisted workflow on Pasqal Cloud, available as a plugin for agentic coding environments (including Claude Code, Cursor and Codex), that takes a defined scientific idea to a running QPU experiment - extracting the protocol, building a hardware-ready job, validating it in emulation, submitting it through the cloud and processing the results. Experiments run on the three Pasqal Cloud QPUs available to external users: Ruby (operated by GENCI at CEA, France), FC1 (Sherbrooke, Quebec, Canada) and SA1 (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia). CEO Wasiq Bokhari: 'The bottleneck in quantum computing is shifting.'
quarterly_data.figure: three cloud QPUs available to external users
